short_name: Intraoperator CV in whole blood
expected: 5 of 195 local and 2 of 195 central with a median of 0.03 for both
quote: On the other hand, in WB intra-assay analysis, CV values were excellent (by far below 0.20) for almost all operators (only 5/195 and 2/195 above the 0.20 threshold), with maximum CV values of 0.28 and 0.29, respectively, and a median CV value of 0.03 for both local and central analyses

short_name: Z-score never unsatisfactory in central analysis

short_name: Z-score unsatisfactory in local analysis

short_name: The reference operator scores among the best
expected: operator M in the best group of all operators
quote: Of note, ex post analysis of reference operator (ROP: Op_M) performance revealed that this operator reached one of the best scores among all operators

short_name: CD8 naive is the least reliable parameter in cPBMC
expected: CD8_N outside the acceptable range for CV and for bias and for ICC
quote: Specifically, the CD8-N subset proved to be out of the acceptability range for both accuracy (CV and Bias) and agreement (ICC), thus turning out to be the less reliable parameter under study

short_name: CD4 terminally differentiated has the worst precision
expected: CD4_TD worst on CV and on bias with acceptable ICC
quote: Distinctively, CD4-TD cells showed the worst CV and bias values both in the interoperator study of variability and in the intraoperator analysis of precision, while their agreement among operators was acceptable in both cPBMC and WB settings

short_name: Precision follows population size
expected: CD3 and CD4 and CD8 below the twelve naive and memory subsets
quote: As expected, the median CV was lower for abundant populations (i.e., CD3+ cells within lymphocytes, and CD4+ or CD8+ cells within CD3+ T cells), and higher for less-represented and poorly resolved subsets, such as CD4+ TD cells

short_name: Excluding poor performers improves agreement
expected: 2 of 15 parameters still below 0.75 and they are CD3_CM and CD4_CM
quote: This selection improved operator concordance for most parameters, even if 2 out of 15 (CD3-CM and CD4-CM) were still below 0.75 thresholds

short_name: Two components carry the parent population variance
expected: 99.4 percent in the first two components
quote: In WB, the PCA analysis revealed that in parent populations (CD3+, CD4+, and CD8+; Figures 6(a)-6(c)), the first two components accounted for 99.4% of total variance

short_name: Two components carry most subset variance
expected: 63.9 percent in the first two components
quote: On the other hand, PCA of naive/memory cell subsets (Figures 6(d)-6(f)) revealed that 63.9% of the variance was represented in a 2-dimensional space

short_name: Dispersion is wider in locally analysed whole blood
expected: whole blood local wider than cPBMC local and centralisation reduces it more in whole blood
quote: Dispersion of frequency profiles was far more evident in locally analysed WB as compared to cPBMC samples. However, centralisation reduced it to a greater extent in WB setting

short_name: The cPBMC preparation carries an unexpected phenotype
expected: CD4 over CD8 below the expected value and a high CD8 terminally differentiated frequency
quote: Of note, regarding cPBMC plots, we found a CD4/CD8 ratio lower than the normal expected value and a very high percentage of TD CD8 T cells with a consequently altered relative proportion of the other memory subsets
